name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the grandstands, captivated by the team dynamics as much as the roaring engines. After earning a degree in Human Resources Management from the University of Lisbon, he sought to merge his professional skills with his passion. He started in a small karting team, managing logistics and personnel, quickly proving his aptitude for handling the complex demands of a high-pressure environment.

At Crown Racing, Ricardo focuses on building a supportive and collaborative team environment. He believes that a happy and motivated team is a performant team. He is known for his proactive approach, anticipating potential conflicts and addressing them before they escalate. His strength lies in his ability to mediate effectively, ensuring every team member feels heard and valued, contributing to the collective success of Crown Racing on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Ricardo has a warm smile and an approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Knows the birthday of every member of the team and always organizes a small celebration.
